leadingGoal: Work at the pace and fee of the best of the trade: a signed contract for every 800 dials, four closed assignments a month, at the trade's surveyed average fee.

values.dialsPerContract: 800 to 1,500 (the best of the range is 800)

measures.means: dials logged for each order that reached contracted
orders closed each month of the period
fees received over the period (four a month at the average fee); what is captured above it is the value-added pool

exposure.upside: value captured above the target is shared under the owner-household chain-group contract
exposure.downside: a shortfall leaves no pool to share, and a sustained shortfall reopens the acquisitions lead office to bids
